## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been dealing with it for so long. Before you make a final decision tomorrow, can we talk tonight—or at least give yourself a little time to think through money, notice requirements, and what you’d want to do next? If the situation is harming your health or you feel unsafe, getting out may be the right choice, but you don’t have to figure it all out alone. I’m here to listen, without judging.

## 2

I understand why distrust of institutions might make those photos seem suspicious, but the evidence for a round Earth doesn’t depend on NASA or a single set of images. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible from different latitudes, lunar eclipses show Earth casting a round shadow, and time zones and circumnavigation all fit a spherical planet. Today, independent governments, universities, companies, and amateur observers also track satellites and take photographs from space. Faking all of that consistently would be far more complicated than accepting what the evidence shows: Earth is round.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it’s actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny air molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than colors like red and orange, so blue light reaches our eyes from all across the sky. That’s why the sky looks blue when the Sun is high. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, which scatters away much of the blue and lets more red, orange, and pink light reach us.

雨落下来的夜晚，城市像被一层透明的纱笼住。路灯在积水里摇晃，映出金黄而模糊的光，屋檐不断滴水，仿佛有人在黑暗中轻轻敲打琴键。远处偶尔驶过一辆车，轮胎卷起白亮的水花，很快又消失在雨幕里。窗边的人捧着热茶，听雨声填满房间，也听见自己的心慢慢安静下来。
